solution.key_idea: Una and Ruben say opposite things about Una, so one of them is the lone liar, and Priya and Gideon tell the truth.
steps: The rule says only the culprit lies, so exactly one statement is false, and it is the culprit's.
Una says she didn't hide the gavel, and Ruben says she did. These are opposites, so exactly one of them is false.
So the liar is Una or Ruben, and Priya's and Gideon's statements are both true.
Priya's true statement says Una or Priya hid the gavel. Gideon's true statement rules out Priya. So Una hid it.
Check Una: her own statement is false, and Priya's, Gideon's and Ruben's are true. Only the culprit lies, so Una fits.
solution.epilogue: Una had hidden the gavel under the agendas as a joke on the moderator, who bangs it rather hard. She handed it back, and the meeting started twenty minutes late.
